subject: Big order for Friday - wedding brunch
body:
Hi Marieke,

We're doing the brunch for a wedding on Saturday (about 120 people) so this one is a lot bigger than normal. For Friday please:

20 cases Haverland oat
12 cases whole milk 1L
6 boxes butter croissants
6 boxes pain au chocolat
10 cases orange juice 1L
4 bags house blend

Can you confirm you can do this?

Thanks!
Aisha
The Little Fern
